title: barista maven.json
description: Maven registry (user level ~/.barista/maven.json); missing file means an empty registry

installations.description: Registered maven installations in declaration order

name.description: Unique logical name (auto-named maven-<version> by add/discover/install, e.g. maven-3.9.11)

path.description: Absolute maven home (the directory containing bin/mvn)

managed.description: True when installed by barista maven install (under installDir); eligible for barista maven uninstall

default.description: Name of the default maven installation (set by barista maven set-default); overridden by workspace properties.json "maven.default"

jdk.description: JDK spec used to run maven (major like "17" or a jdk registry name; resolved against ~/.barista/jdk.json); overridden by workspace properties.json "jdk"

installDir.description: Install root for barista maven install (set by barista maven set-install-dir); must be an absolute path (~ allowed); default is the builtin ~/.barista/toolchains/maven
